name: foundry-copilot
description: GitHub Copilot–style coding assistant locked to Microsoft Foundry models.

chatParticipants.name: foundry
chatParticipants.description: Chat with a Microsoft Foundry model — hard-locked, Entra-authenticated.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain the selected code or the active file.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Diagnose and fix bugs in the selected code.

commands.name: tests
commands.description: Generate unit tests for the selected code.

commands.name: doc
commands.description: Add documentation comments to the selected code.

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Run the tool-using agent loop on your workspace.

foundryCopilot.endpoint.markdownDescription: Your Microsoft Foundry endpoint URL. Must end in one of: `.services.ai.azure.com`, `.cognitiveservices.azure.com`, `.openai.azure.com`, or `.inference.ml.azure.com`. The sidecar **rejects everything else** (hard lock).
foundryCopilot.endpoint.patternErrorMessage: Endpoint must be HTTPS and end in a Microsoft Foundry domain (.services.ai.azure.com, .cognitiveservices.azure.com, .openai.azure.com, or .inference.ml.azure.com).

foundryCopilot.embeddingDeployment.description: Deployment name for embeddings (used by RAG).

foundryCopilot.agent.allowWrite.markdownDescription: Permit the `fs_write` tool. **Disabled by default** for safety; turn on to let the agent create/overwrite files in the workspace.

foundryCopilot.agent.allowShell.markdownDescription: Permit the `shell` tool. **Disabled by default** for safety; turn on to let the agent run shell commands in the workspace.

foundryCopilot.mcp.servers.markdownDescription: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to launch on activation. Each entry is `{ id, command, args?, env? }`. Tools exposed by these servers become available to the agent loop as `mcp__{id}__{tool}`.

id.description: Stable id used in tool names.
